items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Rosalind Research for trusted life-sciences access
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 發布 GPT-6 Rosalind Research，供可信生命科學研究使用
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s October 30 system-card addendum and Business release notes introduce GPT-6 Rosalind Research (API id gpt-6-rosalind), a biology/drug-discovery configuration that reuses GPT-6 Astra weights with no additional training and adjusted refusals, available only via trusted-access review.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10月30日系統卡附錄與商務發行說明推出 GPT-6 Rosalind Research（API id gpt-6-rosalind），為生物學／藥物發現配置，直接沿用 GPT-6 Astra 權重、無額外訓練並調整拒絕行為，僅透過可信存取審查提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a refusal-and-access product on existing weights rather than a newly trained model, letting OpenAI serve dual-use biology research under institutional controls while charging a premium. Independent verification of the reduced dual-use refusals and long-term safety under the High Biological/Chemical rating remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是在既有權重上調整拒絕與存取的產品，而非新訓練模型，讓 OpenAI 能在機構控管下服務雙用途生物學研究並收取溢價。減少雙用途拒絕的實際效果以及在 High 生物／化學評級下的長期安全性，仍缺乏獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: GPT-Rosalind-6 uses the same weights as GPT-6 Astra. We did not add training data or perform additional post-training for this release.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-Rosalind-6 使用與 GPT-6 Astra 相同的權重。我們並未為此版本新增訓練資料或進行額外的後訓練。

links.label: OpenAI Help Center Model Release Notes

items_flat.title_en: Mistral releases open weights for 1-trillion-parameter Large 4
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 釋出約1兆參數 Large 4 開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral released the open weights of Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk), a multimodal MoE model with roughly 1 trillion total parameters (about 52 billion active), on or around October 29 under its ecosystem open-weight license on Hugging Face. The company highlights gains in agentic coding and cybersecurity after additional reinforcement learning.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 約於10月29日在 Hugging Face 以生態系統開源權重授權釋出 Mistral Large 4（Le Chonk）權重，這是約1兆總參數（約520億啟用）的多模態 MoE 模型。公司強調在額外強化學習後，於代理式編碼與網路安全上的提升。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the largest recent open-weight frontier-class release, improving access for organizations that prefer self-hosting. Reported benchmark gains are company-sourced and still trail leading closed models on many agentic tasks; the license restricts certain Model-as-a-Service offerings.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是近期最大規模的開源權重前沿級釋出，提升偏好自託管組織的存取能力。所報基準提升主要來自公司來源，在許多代理任務上仍落後領先封閉模型；授權對部分 Model-as-a-Service 商業模式有限制。
items_flat.quote: We release the weights of Le Chonk, advancing the frontier of open models in agentic coding and cybersecurity.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們釋出 Le Chonk 的權重，推動開源模型在代理式編碼與網路安全上的前沿。

links.label: Coverage of Mistral Large 4 open-weights release

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic renames Max 20x to Ultra and removes five-hour limit for verified accounts
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Max 20x 更名為 Ultra，並為已驗證帳戶移除五小時限制
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s help center documents and an October 30 X post state that the $200 Max 20x plan is now called Ultra, with prices unchanged. Verified Ultra accounts no longer face the rolling five-hour usage cap; weekly limits (10× Pro) and other constraints remain. Newer accounts keep a temporary cap until verification.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 說明中心與10月30日 X 貼文指出，$200 的 Max 20x 方案現更名為 Ultra，價格不變。已驗證的 Ultra 帳戶不再受滾動五小時使用上限約束；每週限制（Pro 的10倍）及其他限制仍保留。較新帳戶在完成驗證前仍有暫時上限。
items_flat.analysis_en: Removing the short-cycle cap on the top consumer plan reduces friction for heavy Claude Code users without increasing total weekly allowance, while the verification step adds a light anti-abuse control. It does not expand overall capacity or change model access.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 移除頂層消費方案的短週期上限，降低重度 Claude Code 使用者的摩擦，但未增加總每週額度；驗證步驟則增加輕量反濫用控管。整體容量與模型存取並未擴大。
items_flat.quote: We're also removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting today with most existing subscribers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們也為已驗證的 Ultra 帳戶移除5小時限制，今天起從大多數現有訂閱者開始。

links.label: Anthropic on X (Max to Ultra rename)
Claude Help Center: What is the Ultra plan?

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind expands Gemini-powered PlanAssist to 12 more UK councils
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 將 Gemini 驅動的 PlanAssist 擴至再12個英國議會
items_flat.summary_en: DeepMind’s October 31 blog post states that PlanAssist, built with Gemini, is moving from three pilot councils into a 12-month beta with 12 additional English local authorities (15 total). Early pilots cut householder application assessment time by up to 58 percent, with officers retaining final decisions.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepMind 10月31日部落格指出，以 Gemini 打造的 PlanAssist 正從三個試點議會進入12個月測試，再加入12個英格蘭地方當局（共15個）。早期試點將屋主申請評估時間最多減少58%，官員保留最終決定權。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a practical government-deployment story rather than a model release, showing Gemini applied to high-volume administrative work with human oversight retained. The 58 percent figure is company-reported from pilots and the nationwide 2027 offer remains conditional on beta results.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是實務政府部署故事而非模型釋出，顯示 Gemini 應用於高量行政工作並保留人為監督。58% 數字為公司試點報告，2027年全國提供仍取決於測試結果。
items_flat.quote: PlanAssist has shown it can cut the time planning officers spend assessing householder applications by up to 58%.
items_flat.quote_zh: PlanAssist 已顯示能將規劃官員評估屋主申請的時間最多減少58%。

items_flat.title_en: xAI/SpaceXSI to enable default invisible text watermarks on Grok API from November 7
items_flat.title_zh: xAI/SpaceXSI 將自11月7日起對 Grok API 預設啟用不可見文字浮水印
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXSI developer documentation states that starting November 7, 2026, text outputs from grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-4.5, grok-4.3 and three grok-4.20 variants will carry an invisible statistical watermark by default on both Responses and Chat Completions APIs. Team admins can opt out per model after confirming a legal exception; quality and speed claims are unchanged.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXSI 開發者文件指出，自2026年11月7日起，grok-4.7、grok-4.6、grok-4.5、grok-4.3 及三個 grok-4.20 變體的文字輸出，將在 Responses 與 Chat Completions API 上預設帶有不可見統計浮水印。團隊管理員可在確認法律例外後按模型退出；品質與速度宣稱不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The watermark is a compliance mechanism that slightly shapes token selection without adding visible characters or changing length/speed claims. It affects API customers only for now and detection access is application-gated, so practical verification impact remains to be seen.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 浮水印是合規機制，透過輕微影響詞元選擇實現，不添加可見字元，也不改變長度／速度宣稱。目前僅影響 API 客戶，偵測存取需申請，實際驗證影響仍待觀察。
items_flat.quote: Starting November 7, 2026, responses from these models include a watermark. It's on by default, and you can opt out per model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 自2026年11月7日起，這些模型的回應將包含浮水印。預設開啟，您可按模型退出。

links.label: SpaceXSI / xAI Developer Docs – Output Watermarking

items_flat.title_en: Judge denies xAI motion to dismiss NAACP Clean Air Act suit over Southaven turbines
items_flat.title_zh: 法官駁回 xAI 請求駁回 NAACP 針對 Southaven 渦輪機的清潔空氣法訴訟
items_flat.summary_en: On or around October 30, U.S. District Judge Debra M. Brown denied xAI’s motion to dismiss the NAACP’s Clean Air Act lawsuit concerning gas turbines powering the Colossus data center in Southaven, Mississippi. The court found the turbines are subject to permitting requirements and the claims can proceed.
items_flat.summary_zh: 約於10月30日，美國地區法官 Debra M. Brown 駁回 xAI 請求駁回 NAACP 針對密西西比州 Southaven Colossus 資料中心燃氣渦輪機的清潔空氣法訴訟。法院認為渦輪機受許可要求約束，主張可繼續進行。
items_flat.analysis_en: The ruling keeps the permitting and emissions claims alive but does not decide liability. It is an operational and regulatory risk story for xAI’s power infrastructure rather than a model or product change.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此裁決讓許可與排放主張繼續進行，但未判定責任。這是 xAI 電力基礎設施的營運與監管風險故事，而非模型或產品變更。
items_flat.quote: Because the Plant is not a ‘mobile source’ according to the federal regulations…the Plant was not (and is not) exempted from permitting requirements under the Clean Air Act.
items_flat.quote_zh: 根據聯邦法規，該廠並非『移動來源』……該廠過去（及現在）並未豁免清潔空氣法下的許可要求。

items_flat.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities on medical and scientific research with Muse models
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作，以 Muse 模型進行醫學與科學研究
items_flat.summary_en: On October 28 Meta announced partnerships with Caltech, Ohio State College of Medicine, LSU, Indiana University, and UTHealth Houston, providing $2 million in grants plus access to latest Muse models (including Wonder, Spark Open, and Glimmer) for medical and scientific research under controlled terms.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於10月28日宣布與加州理工、俄亥俄州立醫學院、路易斯安那州立大學、印第安納大學及德州大學健康科學中心休士頓分校合作，提供200萬美元補助加上最新 Muse 模型（包括 Wonder、Spark Open 與 Glimmer）存取，供受控醫學與科學研究使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: The program expands academic access to Meta’s newer closed and open-weight models under controlled terms, particularly useful for domain-specific medical work. Funding is modest relative to lab scale and does not alter public model availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫在受控條件下擴大學術界對 Meta 較新封閉與開源權重模型的存取，對領域特定醫學工作尤其有用。資助規模相對實驗室規模有限，且未改變公眾模型可用性。
items_flat.quote: Meta is bringing Superintelligence models, research funding, and direct researcher collaboration to US universities.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta正將超智慧模型、研究資金與直接研究員協作帶給美國大學。

brief_en: No major new lab announcements in the last 12 hours. Day’s picture remains OpenAI’s GPT-6 Rosalind Research (Astra weights, trusted access), Mistral’s open-weight Large 4, Anthropic’s Ultra plan rename, Google’s PlanAssist beta expansion, and xAI’s upcoming API watermark plus ongoing Southaven lawsuit.
brief_zh: 過去12小時無重大新宣布。今日畫面仍是OpenAI GPT-6 Rosalind Research（沿用Astra權重、可信存取）、Mistral Large 4開源權重、Anthropic Ultra方案更名、Google PlanAssist擴至更多英國議會，以及xAI即將啟用的API浮水印與Southaven訴訟。
